Optional: status (query) — Selects approval statuses. Repeat the parameter to OR-match statuses (for example, status=pending&status=rejected). Use status=all alone to disable status filtering.; latest_only (query) — When true, returns the newest revision in each approval chain.; limit (query); offset (query); reviewer_scope (query) — Limits approvals to the specified reviewer scope.; change_type (query) — Limits approvals to the specified mutation type.; rule_id (query) — Filter approvals by rule ID.

name: List rules
description: List rules Returns all rules for an account with optional filtering. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/cloudforce-one/rules
context:
GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/cloudforce-one/rules
Returns all rules for an account with optional filtering.
Required: account_id (path) — Cloudflare account ID.
Optional: namespace (query) — Selects namespaces. Repeat the parameter to select multiple namespaces (for example, namespace=foo&namespace=bar).; path (query) — Selects paths with exact-match semantics. Omit the parameter to return rules from all paths. Pass an empty string (path=) to return only rules with an empty or uncategorized path. Pass a value (for example, path=yara) to match that exact path. Repeat the parameter (for example, path=yara&path=expr) to OR-match multiple paths with SQL `IN (...)` semantics. The `recursive` flag affects only customer-account namespace selection.; recursive (query) — For customer accounts, true enables descendant matching for namespaces. Paths always use exact matching.; search (query); is_public (query) — Limits rules to the specified public visibility.; limit (query); offset (query)
